findings.evidence: Diffed the two files; the declarations and in several cases the tactic scripts coincide up to `M` vs `T.mass`. PR description concedes the overlap ("The three short on-shell identities ... have the same proofs there").
findings.fix: Factor the shared core out in this PR: either a base structure carrying `p`, `pPrime` and the two mass shells that both `OffForwardKinematics` and `ElasticKinematics` extend, or vector-level lemmas in `Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean` (whose docstring already names off-forward kinematics as its consumer) stated for `p p'` with `⟪p,p⟫ₘ = ⟪p',p'⟫ₘ = M²`, e.g. `⟪2⁻¹ • (p + p'), p' - p⟫ₘ = 0` and `⟪2⁻¹ • (p + p'), 2⁻¹ • (p + p')⟫ₘ = M² - ⟪p'-p, p'-p⟫ₘ/4`, with both modules deriving their lemmas from them.
findings.issue: Lines 103-155 and 174 duplicate `GPD.OffForwardKinematics`: `avgMomentum`/`avgMomentum_def` (GPD/Kinematics.lean:171-173), `delta`/`delta_def` (176-178), `tMom`/`tMom_def` (181-183), `p_eq_avgMomentum_sub`/`pPrime_eq_avgMomentum_add` (200-206), `minkowskiProduct_p_pPrime_eq` (286-290), `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_delta_eq_zero` (261), `minkowskiProduct_delta_avgMomentum_eq_zero` (271-273), `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_self_eq` (277-283), `tMom_nonpos` (348) — several proof-for-proof identical (e.g. 150-155 vs 277-283, 143-145 vs 271-273). Two parallel copies of the same elastic-transition API.

findings.evidence: `p = P - Δ/2` and `P·Δ = 0` give `⟪P,p⟫ₘ = ⟪P,P⟫ₘ = T.mass^2 - K.tMom/4`, and `K.tMom ≤ 0` is line 174; both lemmas are stated above line 233 in the same file.
findings.fix: Replace with a single lemma `⟪K.avgMomentum, K.p⟫ₘ = ⟪K.avgMomentum, K.avgMomentum⟫ₘ` (and the `pPrime` analogue) proved by rewriting with `p_eq_avgMomentum_sub` and `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_delta_eq_zero`, then use `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_self_eq` + `tMom_nonpos` at the call site in `exists_isBreitFrame`.
findings.issue: `private lemma sq_mass_le_minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum` re-expands `avgMomentum` from the mass shells, re-deriving what earlier lines already provide: `p_eq_avgMomentum_sub` (118) plus `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_delta_eq_zero` (135) give `⟪P, p⟫ₘ = ⟪P, P⟫ₘ` (same for `pPrime` via 122), and `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_self_eq` (149) with `tMom_nonpos` (174) give `M² ≤ ⟪P, P⟫ₘ`. It is also an ∧-bundle where the two halves are the same fact.

findings.evidence: `spatialPart_sub` already exists at BasicExtensions.lean:54 and is unused by this module; `spatialCLM` is a `→L[ℝ]` so `map_add`/`map_smul` apply directly (`spatialCLM_apply_eq_spatialPart`, Basic.lean:358).
findings.fix: Add `spatialPart_add` and `spatialPart_smul` beside the existing `Lorentz.Vector.spatialPart_sub` in `EpsilonEridani/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/BasicExtensions.lean:54` (one line each, from `spatialCLM`'s `map_add`/`map_smul`, `Physlib/.../Vector/Basic.lean:352`), then derive all three from `p_eq_avgMomentum_sub` / `pPrime_eq_avgMomentum_add` and `h.spatialPart_avgMomentum`.
findings.issue: Spatial-part algebra is done componentwise by hand in three places instead of via linearity: `isBreitFrame_iff_spatialPart_pPrime` (263-272, `ext i`/`linarith`) and the identical `h0 : ∀ i, K.avgMomentum (Sum.inr i) = 0` block repeated in `IsBreitFrame.spatialPart_p` (313-318) and `IsBreitFrame.spatialPart_pPrime` (321-326).

summary: Nine declarations (the P/Δ/t core and its identities) are copied verbatim from EpsilonEridani.Particles.Parton.GPD.Kinematics.OffForwardKinematics, including proofs, instead of being factored into shared material; a private helper also re-derives what two earlier lemmas in the same file already give. Everything else (Target, Breit frame, ofLiteratureT) is new and reuses Physlib/Mathlib API well.
